jobs.title: Technical Project Manager / Delivery Manager (m/w)
jobs.description:
Postes à pourvoir
Technical Project Manager / Delivery Manager (m/w)
Taux d'occupation
100%
Début
immediately or by appointment
Durée
unlimited
Lieu de travail
Urdorf
Ärztekasse Genossenschaft provides business process outsourcing and eHealth solutions to health professionals so they get relief from administration and can focus on medical work.
In the context of an innovation initiative, Ärztekasse is renewing and extending their products. To support this digitalization step, we are looking for smart and experienced engineers to contribute and shape clever and creative solutions for a meaningful industry.
About the role
We are looking for a Technical Project Manager with a strong software engineering background to help drive our ongoing software modernization journey.
Our environment consists of multiple mid-sized software solutions with complex interdependencies. As we replace legacy systems, reduce technical debt, and introduce modern technologies and new products, we need someone who can maintain technical and organizational overview across initiatives.
This role combines project leadership, technical understanding, and solution thinking. You will operate at the intersection of engineering, architecture, and business – ensuring that projects deliver sustainable technical solutions rather than isolated implementations.
This is not a traditional administrative PM role. We are looking for someone who understands software systems deeply and can actively guide technical decisions while ensuring structured delivery. Your focus will be on building sustainable systems, not just project completion.
Responsibilities
Project & Delivery Leadership
- Lead software development and modernization projects end-to-end
- Define project scope, milestones, delivery plans, and execution strategies
- Manage risks, dependencies, and cross-system impacts
- Contribute to improving software delivery processes and SDLC
- Ensure high-quality and reliable software delivery
Technical Coordination & Architecture Alignment
- Maintain a holistic overview of system landscapes and integrations
- Collaborate closely with developers, architects, and product stakeholders
- Align architecture with delivery needs across multiple initiatives
- Challenge solutions when they increase complexity or technical debt
- Support solution design discussions and architectural decision-making
- Promote scalable, maintainable, and modern engineering practices
Required Experience
- Strong background in software development (former developer or engineer)
- Solid understanding of software architecture, system integration, and distributed systems
- Ability to understand codebases and technical trade-offs without necessarily coding daily
- Experience working across multiple teams / initiatives
- Experience working with modern software development practices (Agile, DevOps, CI/CD) are a strong plus
Desired Skills
- Background as Technical Lead, Solution Architect, or Engineering Lead
- Experience balancing delivery pressure with long-term technical quality
- Strong analytical and systems thinking mindset
- Comfortable operating in partially evolving or ambiguous environments
- Good understanding of backend systems, APIs, and integrations
- Experience with complex systems, modernization or legacy transformation projects
- Fluent in English and intermediate in German (B1 or higher)
Further information
A stimulating environment helps to find cool solutions to challenging complex requirements. We work in small agile teams where you can have impact and influence. You will find sharp engineers to have inspiring discussions with. We are solution-driven, but we don’t neglect the fun factor.
We look forward to receiving your application!
We look forward to receiving your application by e-mail at [email protected] .

jobs.title: Test Automation Engineer (m/f)
jobs.description:
Postes à pourvoir
Test Automation Engineer (m/f)
Taux d'occupation
80-100%
Début
immediately or by appointment
Durée
unlimited
Lieu de travail
Urdorf
Ärztekasse Genossenschaft provides business process outsourcing and eHealth solutions to health professionals so they get relief from administration and can focus on medical work. In the context of an innovation initiative, Ärztekasse is renewing and extending their products.
To support this digitalization step, we are looking for smart and experienced engineers to contribute and shape clever and creative solutions for a meaningful industry.
Specifically, we are looking for a test automation engineer to ensure that our products are comprehensively tested before they are handed over to our customers.
Main Tasks
- Plan, design, develop, and execute automated test scenarios. Depending on the project, the automation needs to be done on API level, Web GUI and/or end to end
- The automated test cases need to be identified based on risk of the according functionality
- Taking full responsibility for the test of components, including preparation of test cases (manual and automated), preparing test phases, creation of test strategy and test plan
- The automation shall cover functional and non-functional testing
- Build up regression test suites which are part of the continuous integration and build process
- Identify and automate critical performance and security tests
- Prepare test data for both – function and non-functional tests
- Collaborate with requirements engineers and business analysts to identify most beneficial test cases
Requirements
- At least 5 years of experience in software development/ test automation.
- Experience in testing Java and Web (Angular, REST, SOAP) applications.
- Strong and proven test automation skills
- Proven track record in taking overall responsibility for the testing of components
- Code design affinity. Familiarity with key architecture and design principles.
- Experience with testing tools and frameworks (like Selenium, Cucumber, Gherkin, Postman, Rest Assured)
- Deep expertise in Digital Frameworks like Selenium (Web UI), PlayWright, Rest Assured (API), SQL(Databases: Sybase and PostgreSQL).
- Hands-on experience delivering automation with a focus on continuous integration/continuous deployment. (Git, Bamboo)
- Hands-on experience with scripting languages (e.g., Python, Java, JavaScript, or Shell scripting).
- Proven experience with Agile methodologies and exposure to tools like JIRA, Confluence and X-Ray for Test Management.
- High code quality and good documentation skills.
- Experience in the Swiss healthcare sector
- Understanding of security concepts is a plus
- Self-driven and self-organized
- Analytical mindset with fast comprehension
- English is required
What we offer
- 40 hours per week
- Highly motivated team
- Modern office space
- Good public transport connections
- 25 days holiday, 30 days holiday from age 50
- Private accident insurance
Further information

Taux d'occupation
100%
Début

Durée
à durée indéterminée
Lieu de travail
Thônex
Coopérative active depuis plus de 60 ans dans le domaine de la facturation et de la gestion de cabinets médicaux, nous comptons une dizaine d’agences et employons plus de 350 collaborateurs au niveau national. Notre principale clientèle est constituée aussi bien de médecins, spécialistes et collaborateurs paramédicaux que de cliniques et d’hôpitaux.
Nos applications métier reposent sur des bases SAP ASE (Sybase) et MS SQL Server dont la disponibilité est critique pour notre activité.
Votre mission
- Administration et exploitation
- Assurer l’administration et le bon fonctionnement des bases SAP ASE (Sybase) et MS SQL Server de production
- Garantir la disponibilité, la fiabilité et la performance des bases supportant nos applications métier

jobs.description:
Postes à pourvoir
Senior Software Engineer (m/w) 100%
Taux d'occupation
100%
Début
immediately or by appointment
Durée
unlimited
Lieu de travail
Thônex
Ärztekasse Genossenschaft provides business process outsourcing and eHealth solutions to health professionals so they get relief from administration and can focus on medical work.
In the context of an innovation initiative, Ärztekasse is renewing and extending their products. To support this digitalization step, we are looking for smart and experienced engineers to contribute and shape clever and creative solutions for a meaningful industry.
Main Tasks
- Design, implementation & maintenance of applications and services for our billing tracking products
- Collaboration with requirements engineers and business analysts to detail and clarify understanding and requirements
- Support of testing team in regards of functional and non-functional tests of the implemented applications
- Participation in definition and design of solution architectures, under the guidance of the tech lead
- Documentation of code and design
- Implementation of proofs of concept to validate and show solution architectures
- Participation in the definition of technology and tool stacks to be used for new solutions
- Contribute to raising the technical level of the team through code reviews and day-to-day collaboration with less experienced colleagues
Requirements
- Bachelor degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or the equivalent in experience
- At least 8 years of experience in software development
- Strong backend development experience with server-side development (WebAPI, multi-threaded systems) using .NET (C#, Entity Framework, Dependency Injection)
- Strong experience with SQL language (Postgre, SQL Server, Sybase)
- Knowledge of architecture and development patterns (e.g. Microservices, CQRS, Domain Driven Design, SOLID, Unit Testing)
- Experience with CI/CD (Git, Azure Devops, Bitbucket, Bamboo)
- Knowledge of authentication/authorization services and integration is a plus
- Knowledge of containerization (Kubernetes) is a plus
- Knowledge of ETL solutions (Apache Airflow) is a plus
- Experience with VB language is a plus
- Knowledge of Agile methodologies
- Collaborative with excellent communication skills
- Self-driven and self-organized
- French is required: C1 or higher
- English is required: B2 or higher
- German is a plus
Team Context
You’ll join a team of 6 developers with heterogeneous seniority (from junior to senior), working on our billing tracking products, under the guidance of the team’s tech lead. As a senior profile, you’ll bring strong technical expertise to the team, contribute actively to architecture discussions — while remaining hands-on in the codebase. You will be working alongside both confirmed developers you can help grow and senior engineers to exchange ideas with. We are solution-driven, but we don’t neglect the fun factor !
What we offer
– 40h/per week
– 1 day home office option
– Highly innovative and international working environment
– Free parking
– Language trainings
We look forward to receiving your application !
We look forward to receiving your application on jobUp.

Thônex
Coopérative active depuis plus de 60 ans dans le domaine de la facturation et de la gestion de cabinets médicaux, nous comptons une dizaine d’agences et employons plus de 350 collaborateurs au niveau national. Nos services soutiennent quotidiennement des milliers de professionnels de la santé : leur disponibilité est critique.
PostgreSQL est notre plateforme de données cible et son périmètre s’élargit à chaque vague de migration.
Ce poste couvre à la fois l’exploitation quotidienne de nos bases PostgreSQL — disponibilité, fiabilité et performance en production — et la contribution à la conception et à l’industrialisation de notre plateforme de données, en collaboration étroite avec les équipes Platform Management.
Votre mission
- Exploitation et disponibilité
- Assurer l’administration et le bon fonctionnement des bases PostgreSQL de production
- Garantir la disponibilité, la fiabilité et la performance des services de données
- Gérer les sauvegardes, les restaurations, la réplication, la haute disponibilité et la reprise après sinistre, et en tester régulièrement le bon fonctionnement
- Planifier et exécuter les mises à jour, correctifs et changements en production
- Surveiller les bases, analyser les métriques et anticiper les problèmes de capacité et de performance
- Réaliser le tuning et l’optimisation des requêtes et des instances
- Conception et industrialisation
- Contribuer à la conception des architectures de bases de données et à leur déploiement sur notre plateforme
- Participer à l’automatisation du provisionnement, des sauvegardes, des mises à jour et des bascules
- Travailler avec les équipes Platform Management à l’évolution de la plateforme de données
- Définir et maintenir les standards d’exploitation des bases déployées sur la plateforme
- Gestion des incidents et des problèmes
- Traiter les incidents de niveau 2/3 sur le périmètre bases de données
- Analyser les causes racines et piloter les actions correctives durables
- Participer à une rotation d’astreinte en dehors des heures ouvrables
- Contribuer à l’amélioration continue des procédures d’exploitation
- Migration et accompagnement
- Participer à la mise en œuvre de la migration des bases historiques vers PostgreSQL
- Valider les performances et la conformité des bases migrées
- Apporter un support aux équipes de développement et aux équipes métier
- Documenter les procédures, les runbooks et les bonnes pratiques, et automatiser les tâches récurrentes
Votre profil
- Formation : Bachelor ou Master en informatique, bases de données ou formation jugée équivalente
- Expérience : minimum 4 ans en administration et exploitation de bases PostgreSQL en environnement de production
- Compétences techniques
- Solide expérience en administration PostgreSQL : réplication, sauvegarde et restauration, HA/DR
- Expérience du tuning et de l’optimisation des performances
- Maîtrise de SQL et de PL/pgSQL
- Expérience des outils de supervision et d’alerting
- Scripting (Shell, Python) pour l’automatisation des tâches d’exploitation
- Bonnes connaissances en sécurité des bases de données
- Connaissance des processus ITIL (incident, problème, changement) : un avantage
- Une expérience de bases de données déployées sur Kubernetes est un atout
- Une expérience d’autres moteurs (SAP ASE, MS SQL, MariaDB, MongoDB, Redis) est appréciée
Langues
- Français ou allemand courant
- Anglais niveau B1/B2 minimum requis
La seconde langue nationale est un véritable atout
Soft skills
- Sens du service et de la responsabilité opérationnelle
- Autonomie, rigueur et esprit d’initiative
- Capacité à travailler en équipe et à partager ses connaissances
- Bonne communication pour collaborer avec les différentes parties prenantes
Nous offrons
- Une plateforme en pleine croissance et un rôle central dans sa fiabilité
- Une formation dans le domaine de la facturation médicale ainsi que sur nos logiciels métier
- Une grande autonomie dans le travail
- Une grande entreprise … à taille humaine (env. 350 employés)
- La culture du tutoiement à travers les hiérarchies
- Des horaires flexibles et la possibilité de télétravail
- Une caisse de pension stable et solide
